items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: I just remember his name. Aida Cheri. No, not Aida Cheri. That's Sidney- Correa or something? That's Sidney Correa, Simon Moreira, John Moreira, August Russo, I think. I was known as Josephine. August Russo, I think it was playing as Josephine.

ctx.x: players in that band, Bill? Who was that? Did you have any saxophone players? Saxophone players? Saxophone, sure.

Who was playing on the sax? Well, I remember the first on the saxophone had Joe Rouget, Edmund Hall. Edmund Hall. Oh, yeah. And Clarence Hall. See? So Edmund Hall, he jumped down and they took Earl Peterson. He don't play anymore. He's on the road now. He's a- We met him on a train, yeah. Yeah. And then after that, well, that's the way it's switched up about. But our first band was with Papa Celestine. And we did that recording and all of that. My Josephine and all of that.
